title: Find And Replace In String
description: Replace substrings in a source string based on starting indices and target replacements.
pseudocode:
1. map = sort indices with sources/targets by index desc
2. for each (i, src, tgt) in map:
3.   if s.substring(i, i + src.length) == src:
4.     s = s.slice(0, i) + tgt + s.slice(i + src.length)
5. return s

steps.note: Sorted indices by position descending to prevent index shifting issues.
